title: Cuzick's trend test
description: Rank-based test for a monotone trend across ordered groups.

feature_dim.title: Feature dimension
feature_dim.description: Name of the feature axis in the expression table.

group_dim.title: Metadata sample dimension
group_dim.description: Name of the sample axis in the metadata table.

group_label.title: Group column
group_label.description: Metadata column that holds the ordered group label.

group_order.title: Group order
group_order.description: Explicit group order; defaults to the sorted labels.

scores.title: Group scores
scores.description: One score per group in the group order; defaults to 1, 2, ..., k.

continuity.title: Continuity correction
continuity.description: Shift T by 0.5 towards its expectation before computing z.
